Maya S: Hi all — quick onboarding benefits/payroll check. I enrolled in medical+dental but didn't get a benefits welcome email. Also uploaded my dependent docs but Workday still shows 'Docs Needed'. Any idea timing?

Priya (People Ops): Welcome Maya! :wave: Welcome emails sometimes go to spam; search for 'Benefits Enrollment' from our carrier. Dependent docs verification usually takes 3–7 business days after upload. Which documents did you upload?

Maya S: Uploaded marriage certificate + spouse SSN (redacted on public view) two days ago. Also, I picked HSA — does Redwood seed HSAs for new hires?

Benefits Team: If you enrolled in HSA with a qualifying HDHP, check the vendor portal for employer contributions. Some teams receive a small seed contribution within 30 days; not all plans include it. We'll check your enrollment file and confirm.

Maya S: Cool. One payroll question too: my offer said PTO is prorated first year. How does that show on the paystub or in Workday?

Payroll Bot: PTO accruals are not line items on paystubs. Check Workday > Time Off > Balances for current accruals. Pro-rated first-year accrual is applied by start-date logic and shows as monthly accruals on the balance page.

Maya S: I also submitted a $95 chair mat reimbursement via Expensify under newhire-setup — shows pending manager approval but my manager is traveling. How are those handled?

Priya (People Ops): Manager approval is required; if manager is OOO they can approve via Expensify mobile. If it blocks essentials, DM me the Expensify link and we'll triage an interim approval. Finance pays on the next AP run after approval (Tue/Thu).

Nate K: FYI — for cards, carriers often let you create an e-card in their app immediately. If docs are pending, the physical card may be held until verification completes.

Maya S: Last tiny one: I changed my address in Workday yesterday — will that automatically re-ship cards if verification finishes?

Benefits Team: Update Workday first (good), then DM People Ops for a manual reissue request. Carriers print weekly so we can request a re-ship once docs verified.

Maya S: Thanks all! I'll DM Priya the Expensify link and check the carrier app. :thumbsup:
